notes: Each of the 10 model timesteps is a 1-second mean of 10 raw 10 Hz samples.
The full input window covers 10 seconds of history and the model emits one
prediction per second. Feeding raw 10 Hz samples straight into the 10-slot
buffer would collapse the window from 10 s to 1 s, which is not the
distribution the network was trained on.

heads.displacement: Velocity delta (m/s) with kinematic residual connection
